entries.title: Psalms 5:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician; with the Nehiloth. A Psalm of David.>> Give ear to my words, O Jehovah, Consider my meditation.

entries.title: Psalms 5:2
segments: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God; For unto thee do I pray.

entries.title: Psalms 5:3
segments: O Jehovah, in the morning shalt thou hear my voice; In the morning will I order [my prayer] unto thee, and will keep watch.

entries.title: Psalms 5:4
segments: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: Evil shall not sojourn with thee.

entries.title: Psalms 5:5
segments: The arrogant shall not stand in thy sight: Thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 5:6
segments: Thou wilt destroy them that speak lies: Jehovah abhorreth the blood-thirsty and deceitful man.

entries.title: Psalms 5:7
segments: But as for me, in the abundance of thy lovingkindness will I come into thy house: In thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

entries.title: Psalms 5:8
segments: Lead me, O Jehovah, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; Make thy way straight before my face.

entries.title: Psalms 5:9
segments: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; Their inward part is very wickedness; Their throat is an open sepulchre; They flatter with their tongue.

entries.title: Psalms 5:10
segments: Hold them guilty, O God; Let them fall by their own counsels; Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions; For they have rebelled against thee.

entries.title: Psalms 5:11
segments: But let all those that take refuge in thee rejoice, Let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: Let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

entries.title: Psalms 5:12
segments: For thou wilt bless the righteous; O Jehovah, thou wilt compass him with favor as with a shield.
